description.zh:
加速类型，取值：

- play：播流加速。
- publish：推流加速。
description.en:
The acceleration type. Valid values:

- play: streaming acceleration.

- publish: stream ingest acceleration.

description.zh: 复用的加速通道。当Reuse为yes时必填。
description.en: The ID of the acceleration instance that you want to reuse. This parameter is required if you set Reuse to yes.

description.zh: 加速带宽，单位：Mbps。当Reuse为no时必填。
description.en: The maximum bandwidth for acceleration. Unit: Mbps. This parameter is required if you set Reuse to no.

description.zh:
是否复用已有加速通道，取值：
- yes：复用已有加速通道。
- no：新建加速通道。
description.en:
Specifies whether to reuse an existing acceleration instance. Valid values:

- yes: Reuse an existing acceleration instance.

- no: Create a new acceleration instance.

description.zh: 直播中心，取值：cn-beijing、cn-shanghai、cn-shenzhen、cn-qingdao、ap-northeast-1、ap-southeast-5、eu-central-1、ap-southeast-1、ap-south-1，分别表示位于北京、上海、深圳、青岛、日本、印尼、德国、新加坡的直播中心。
description.en: The live center. Valid values are cn-beijing, cn-shanghai, cn-shenzhen, cn-qingdao, ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-5, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1, and ap-south-1. These values represent the live centers located in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Qingdao, Japan, Indonesia, Germany, and Singapore.

title.zh: 创建全球加速实例并绑定到直播链路

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口用于创建全球加速实例并绑定到直播链路，需要精确到流粒度，并指明加速的起点和终点。

- AppName与StreamName的名称与播流地址中的AppName与StreamName的名称对应模板才能生效。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to create a Global Accelerator instance and attach it to a live stream channel. You must specify the start and end points of the acceleration at the stream level.

- The template takes effect only if the AppName and StreamName match the corresponding names in the streaming URL.

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 50 per user. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which can affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation within this limit.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-live-private-line --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name live --stream-name testStream --video-center cn-shanghai --acceleration-type play --acceleration-area ap-southeast-1 --reuse no --max-bandwidth 200 --instance-id ga-bp1iovsdpf01ym9su0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateLivePrivateLine --region cn-hangzhou --VideoCenter 'cn-shanghai' --StreamName testStream --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --AccelerationType play --InstanceId 'ga-bp1iovsdpf01ym9su0000' --Reuse no --MaxBandwidth 200 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AccelerationArea 'ap-southeast-1' --AppName live
